text: A muscular male figure with fair skin crouches aggressively. He has short, blonde hair styled in a tousled cut. His face is angular, jaw clenched, teeth bared. He wears a red armband on his right arm, a gold circular pendant around his neck, and a dark loincloth secured by a red belt with gold accents. In his right hand he grips a short dagger. His left arm is extended forward. The background is dark, shadowy foliage.
